clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements for thermoplastic seats and covers for water-closets.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types  -  Type PF moulded from phenolic plastics and Type UF moulded from urea- formaldehyde.

clauses.title: Materials
clauses.text: 3. Materials Seats and Covers : a) Material for type PF seats  and covers shall be phenolic plastics conforming to Grade 2 or 3 of IS 1300 : 1994* b) Material for Type UF seats and covers   shall be  urea-for maldehyde conforming to IS 3389 : 1994+ 3.2 Hinging Device — Bronze or brass or mild steel with nickel chromium plating or aluminnium alloy with anodic coating or suitable plastic (with reinforcement)

clauses.title: Seat
clauses.text: 4.1  Seat — The underside of the seats may be either flat or recessed.  Where the underside is flat, the seat shall be a solid moulding, and where the underside is recessed, the section shall be not less than 3 mm at any point.  The seats may be of the closed or open front pattern (see Fig. 1).

clauses.title: Cover
clauses.text: 4.2 Cover — The cover shall completely cover the aperture of the seat and shall be so designed that it is capable of being raised easily from the seat.

clauses.title: Finish – The surfaces
clauses.text: 4.4 Finish - The surfaces of the seats, covers and components shall be smooth, free from blisters and delamiation and reasonably free from flowlines, contamination, streaking and unintended colour variation.

clauses.title: Hinging Device – The
clauses.text: 4.5 Hinging Device - The bolts shall have a minimum shank length of 65 mm and a coarse thread of M8 size iwithin 25 mm of the flange of fixing to the pan.

clauses.title: Buffers – Each seat
clauses.text: 4.6 Buffers -  Each seat  if not provided with not less than three rubber or plastic buffers of size 25 mm × 40 mm × 10 mm for closed front seats and not less than 4 for open front seats, which shall be securely fixed to underside of the seat. clauses.title: Strength
clauses.text: 5.1 Strength  requirements for seats — Shall withstand, without permanent distortion of the seat or the hinge fittings or damage to any finish, a load of 1 150 N applied for a period of 30 minutes.

clauses.title: Impact
clauses.text: 5.2 Impact  Resistance —  When tested for impact, the seat, cover  buffers  and  hinges   shall show any     visible damage.

clauses.title: Water Absorption
clauses.text: 5.3 Water Absorption — The  increase in mass shall be 0.75 percent, Max and on visual inspection after immersion, it shall shown no impairment.

clauses.title: Rigidity
clauses.text: 5.4 Rigidity Seats  -  The maximum deflection shall be as given below and on visual inspection after the load is removed, Note — For methods of tests refer to Appendices A to K of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS 2548 (Part 1) 1996  Specification for Plastic seats and covers for waterclosets Part 1 Thermoset  seats and covers (fifth revision). the seats shall not show any fracture 5.4.2   Covers — Maximum deflection shall be as given below and on visual inspection after the load is removed, the cover shall not show any fracture Maximum distortion shall be 3mm.

clauses.title: Staining by Seats and Covers
clauses.text: 5.5 Staining by Seats and Covers —   There shall not be any visible colour transfer to the white cloth.

clauses.title: Staining and/or Other Surface
clauses.text: 5.6 Staining and/or Other Surface  Deterioration of Seats and Covers - There shall not be any change of colour or other adverse change in surface characteristics.

clauses.title: Endurance Test
clauses.text: 5.7  Endurance Test  for Seats, Covers and Buffers: Neither seat, cover or buffer should be damaged or dislocated.  This is a type test.
